###### Good to Know Before You Book
The stay
One private villa in Kalpetta town, Wayanad, Kerala. The whole villa is yours: 2 beds, 1 bathroom, kitchen, Wi-Fi and private parking. Pets are welcome.
Check-in and check-out
Check-in from 2 PM, check-out by 11 AM.
How booking works
Choose your dates and send a request. Your dates are held only after the host confirms by email.
Cancellation
Standard dates: full refund (less bank charges) 15 or more days before check-in, 50% at 7 to 14 days. Holiday and peak dates need longer notice. [Cancellation policy](https://www.bwstays.com/footer.html#cancellation)

Nearest airport

Calicut International Airport (Karipur, CCJ), about 80 km by road.

Nearest railway station

Kozhikode (CLT), about 72 km by road.

Bus and taxi

Kalpetta New Bus Stand and the taxi stand are in town, close to the villa.

#### Terms of Service
To make a booking with bw stays& simply fill in the online reservation form or download the reservation form and call or mail to us. Spaces will be confirmed in order of receipt and upon payment of deposit.

Once your reservation has been confirmed it is necessary to make full payment at least 90 days prior to the tour commencement date. Payment for the tour deposit may be made by Visa, Mastercard, cash deposit, internet banking or International Money Transfer.

Payment for the balance of the tour fee may be made by cash deposit, internet banking or International Money Transfer, Visa or Mastercard.

Fees are quoted in United States dollars or Indian Rupees and are inclusive of the GST (18%).

We regret that personal or bank cheques are not accepted. We reserve the right to cancel your booking if payment is not received when due, wherein the Cancellations and Refunds clause, listed below, shall be effected.

#### Cancellations & Refunds
To cancel or change a booking, write to us from the email address or contact form used for the booking, with your name and stay dates. The date and time we receive your request is the cancellation date.

Standard dates. Cancelled 15 or more days before check-in: full refund of the amount paid, less any payment-gateway or bank charges. Cancelled 7 to 14 days before check-in: 50% of the amount paid is refunded. Cancelled less than 7 days before check-in, or no-show: no refund.

Holiday and peak-season stays. A stay is a holiday booking if any night falls on a public holiday, a festival weekend or between 20 December and 5 January. Cancelled 30 or more days before check-in: full refund, less payment-gateway or bank charges. Cancelled 15 to 29 days before check-in: 50% refund. Cancelled less than 15 days before check-in, or no-show: no refund.

Changing dates. You may move a confirmed booking to other dates once, free of charge, up to 7 days before check-in, subject to availability. Any difference in the rate is payable.

Early departure. Unused nights are not refunded.

If we cancel. If bw stays cancels a booking, you receive a full refund of everything you paid, or you may choose new dates.

Weather and events beyond our control. If floods, landslides, road closures or similar events make the stay impossible, we will offer you alternative dates.

Refund timing. Approved refunds go back to the original payment method within 7 to 10 working days.

#### Frequently Asked Questions

What is the cancellation and refund policy at BW Stays Wayanad?
Standard dates: cancel 15 or more days before check-in for a full refund (less payment-gateway or bank charges), 7 to 14 days before for a 50% refund, and less than 7 days before or no-show for no refund. Holiday and peak-season stays (public holidays, festival weekends, 20 December to 5 January): 30 or more days before for a full refund, 15 to 29 days before for 50%, and less than 15 days before or no-show for no refund. You can move a confirmed booking once, free of charge, up to 7 days before check-in, subject to availability. Refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 7 to 10 working days. Full details: https://www.bwstays.com/footer.html#cancellation

What does the villa cost per night?

The villa is listed at INR 2,100 per night on the booking page, for up to 4 adults and 1 child, and the rate includes GST. Each extra child (up to 4 children in all) is INR 400 per night. The final amount is confirmed by the host by email.

How do I book the villa?

Open the booking page, choose your check-in and check-out dates on the calendar, select the villa, enter your details and send the request. A booking is a request: your dates are held only after the host confirms by email. A one-page summary of your request can be saved as a PDF. Booking page: https://www.bwstays.com/bwstays-booking.html

What are the check-in and check-out times?

Check-in from 2 PM, check-out by 11 AM.

How can I check availability?

The calendar on the booking page shows booked and closed dates (dates already requested may show as Requested), and you can choose dates from today up to one year ahead. A requested date is not confirmed yet. The host confirms every booking by email.

How many people can stay in the villa?

The villa takes up to 4 adults and up to 4 children (0 to 12 years); the booking page does not accept more. The nightly rate covers 4 adults and 1 child; each extra child is INR 400 per night (extra bed). The villa has 2 beds and 1 bathroom, a garden and private parking, and pets are allowed.

What amenities does the villa have?

EV charging, private parking, eco-friendly, premium utensils, a kitchen set, bonfire and music, television, online games, high-speed WiFi, security, pet friendly, bathroom amenities, air conditioning, a mountain view and a garden.

Is the villa suitable for a workation?

High-speed WiFi and air conditioning are listed among the villa amenities, so it suits remote work. The WiFi speed is not published, so ask the host if you need a specific bandwidth.

Where is the villa located?

In Kalpetta, Wayanad, Kerala (PIN 673121), close to the city centre. The Places to visit page lists attractions with their driving distance from Kalpetta (https://www.bwstays.com/all-locations-wayanad.html), and the Places to eat page lists restaurants and cafes (https://www.bwstays.com/all-fooding-wayanad.html).

Which places can I visit near the villa?

The site lists waterfalls, view points, lakes, temples, museums, plantations, wildlife sanctuaries and treks around Wayanad, each with a page showing timings, rating and distance from Kalpetta. Nearby EV charging stations and fuel stations are shown on each place page. Start at https://www.bwstays.com/all-locations-wayanad.html

Is there EV charging near the villa?

EV charging is listed among the villa amenities. Every place page also shows nearby public and private charging stations and fuel stations on a map; their positions are approximate.

Can I use the website without internet?

Yes, partly. The website can be installed on a phone (Add to Home Screen) and keeps the pages you have opened, the places, food, charging and fuel lists and the policies available offline. Live availability, sending a booking request, the chat assistant, the weather and the currency rates need an internet connection.

What is the concept behind Black and White Stays?

Colive, Cowork and Coplay: a villa in Kalpetta for staying with family or friends, working remotely, and exploring Wayanad.

Summarize BW Stays Wayanad in one sentence

Black and White Stays is a single villa in Kalpetta, Wayanad for staycations and workations, for up to 4 adults and 4 children, listed at INR 2,100 per night.

## 900 Kandi Glass Bridge, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-900-kandi-romantic-wayanad.html

Experience the perfect blend of remote work and adventure at 900 Kandi in Wayanad. Enjoy heritage charm and explore local attractions at your leisure

### Adventure Tourism & Extreme Trekking

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### 900 Kandi
26 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 6:30 am – 6:30 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (March-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-February)
- Type: Romantic Spots
- Fee: Adult INR 250, child INR 100; zip line INR 350, zip cycling INR 250, adventure swing INR 100
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 99474 60835, +91 95264 81745
900 Kandi: DTPC lists Skypark at 900 Kandi as an eco-friendly adventure park set in forest and hills, with glass bridge walks, ziplining, tree-top trails, light trekking and off-road jeep rides. Entry is INR 250 for adults and INR 100 for children, with separate charges for the zip line, zip cycling, swing and rifle shooting. Bookings are offline only.

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/900-kandi-wayanad).

Ambalavayal: The farm was set up by the Madras government in 1945 under the post-war Wayanad colonisation scheme, became a horticultural research station in 1966 and passed to Kerala Agricultural University after 1972. Tourists may visit its nursery of roses and ornamental plants and buy planting material. It hosts the Pooppoli flower festival around January.

Sources: [rarsamb.kau.in](https://rarsamb.kau.in/rarsamb/history), [keralatourism.org](https://keralatourism.org/wayanad/rars-agriculture-institution.php), [pooppoli.kau.in](https://pooppoli.kau.in/).

## Ananthanatha Swamy Jain Temple, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-ananthanatha-swamy-jain-temple-pilgrimage-wayanad.html

Jain temple of Tirthankara Ananthanatha Swami on Puliyarmala hillock, about 5 km from Kalpetta.

### Green canopies, serene waters & quiet troughs

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Ananthanatha Swamy Temple
4 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Pilgrimage
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Ananthanatha Swamy Jain: The temple is dedicated to Ananthanatha Swami, a Jain Tirthankara. It is believed to have first stood in old Kalpetta (Kalpavathy) and was moved to the Puliyarmala hillock by Mandappa Gowder in 1931. DTPC Wayanad notes that the main idol of the Sultan Bathery Jain temple is now kept here.

Sources: [keralatourism.org](https://keralatourism.org/wayanad/ananthanatha-swami-temple.php), [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/jain-temple-wayanad), [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anantnath_Swami_Temple).

## Arripara Falls, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-arripara-waterfall-wayanad.html

Waterfall on the Iruvanji river near Thiruvambady in Kozhikode district, about 15 km from Thiruvambady town.

### Whispering forests, weeping waters & dreaming valleys

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Arripara falls
37 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 10:00 am – 5:00 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Falls
- Fee: Adults INR 10, children INR 5
- Duration: 1-2 Hours
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 94969 24566
Arripara falls: Arippara drops in several levels over rock and boulders into natural pools, about 15 km from Thiruvambady and 12 km from Thusharagiri falls. Kerala Tourism advises visiting between November and May because the monsoon flow makes it risky.

Sources: [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/destination/arippara-waterfalls-a-tranquil-escape-in-keralas-wilderness-unique/719/), [keralatourism.org](https://keralatourism.org/kerala-article/2019/arippara-waterfalls/951), [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aripara_Falls).

## Bamboo Rafting, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-bamboo-rafting-sporting-wayanad.html

Bamboo rafting on the Kabini River at Kuruva Island, a forested river island near Mananthavady managed for visitors by DTPC Wayanad.

### Twilight jungles, starlit lakes & hidden cradles

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Bamboo Rafting
10 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 9:00 am – 4:30 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Sports
- Fee: Rafting INR 100 adult, INR 50 child (20 min); Kuruva Island entry INR 220 adult, INR 100 student, INR 440 foreigner
- Duration: 1-1.30 Hours
- Holiday: Mon
- Contact: +91 75938 92956
Bamboo Rafting: Visitors reach Kuruva Island, an uninhabited forested island of about 950 acres in the Kabini, by fibre boat or bamboo raft. DTPC lists 20-minute rafting rides as well as kayaking and paddling. Booking is offline only, the daily number of visitors is capped, and the island closes in the monsoon (June to September).

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/kuruva-island-wayanad), [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/malabar/kuruva-island/205), [onmanorama.com](https://onmanorama.com/travel/travel-news/2024/05/19/wayanad-dtpc-bamboo-rafting-kayaking-river-kabani.html).

## Banasura Sagar Hills, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-banasura-sagar-hills-romantic-wayanad.html

A Western Ghats hill range above Banasura Sagar Dam, climbed on a guided forest-department trek that needs prior permission.

### Tropical forests, inland waters & rugged valleys

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Banasura Sagar Hills
29 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 7:30 am – 11:00 am (trek entry, limit 75 persons a day; forest-department permission)
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Romantic
- Fee: Group of 5 INR 4,000 (INR 650 per extra person); students INR 2,500; foreigners INR 7,000
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 493 629 8399, +91 85476 02722
Banasura Sagar Hills: DTPC Wayanad gives the hill as about 6,800 ft high, one of the highest ranges in the Western Ghats, with Banasura Sagar Dam at its foot. The trek follows the Meenmutty-Kattukunnu-Aanchola route and needs forest department permission; guides are available at Meenmutty falls. Entry is 07:30-11:00 for up to 75 people, offline booking only, ages 11+.

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/banasura-hills-wayanad).

## Banasura Sagar Dam, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-banasurasagar-dam-romantic-wayanad.html

Earth dam and reservoir at the foot of the Banasura Hills, about 21 km from Kalpetta, with boating and islands in the reservoir.

### Mountain forests, river bends & valley troughs

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Banasurasagar Dam
21 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 9:00 am – 5:30 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Romantic
- Fee: Adult INR 40, child INR 20
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 493 627 3460
Banasura Sagar Dam: DTPC describes Banasura Sagar as the largest earth dam in India. It is named after Banasura, son of Mahabali, who by local lore did penance on the hills above. The reservoir has small islands formed when land was submerged. Visitors can take speed, pontoon or shikara boats, kayak, ride the zipline or walk in the small park; the Banasura Hill trek also starts nearby.

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/banasura-sagar-dam-wayanad).

## Begur Forest Range, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-begur-wildlife-sanctuary-wayanad.html

A forest range of the North Wayanad Forest Division near Mananthavady and Tholpetty; it is not a separate wildlife sanctuary.

### Begur Forest Range, North Wayanad

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Begur Forest Range
37 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Wildlife
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Begur Forest Range: Begur is a forest range of the North Wayanad Forest Division, along the Mananthavady-Tholpetty side of northern Wayanad. It is not one of the ranges of the Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary, and no visiting programme, timings, fees or contact are published officially; ask the Kerala Forest Department before planning a visit.

## Boys Town Farm, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-boys-town-farm-wayanad.html

A campus about 13 km from Mananthavady where the Wayanad Social Service Society runs a herbal garden, gene park and farm units.

### Medicinal Plants, Holy Springs & Destinations

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Boys Town Farm
43 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Farm
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91-444 444 4444
Boys Town: At Boys Town near Thalappuzha, the Wayanad Social Service Society (founded 1974) runs a herbal garden, a nature care centre, a sericulture unit and a permaculture centre. Its Gene Park for medicinal plants grew out of an Indo-Danish project. No visiting hours or fee are published by an official source.

Sources: [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/destination/boys-town-herbal-garden/284), [keralatourism.org](https://keralatourism.org/wayanad/boys-town-mananthavady.php), [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boys_Town,_Mananthavady).

## Brahmagiri Hills, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-brahmagiri-trucking-wayanad.html

Guided forest trek of about 10 km from the Thirunelli forest camp to the Brahmagiri summit, about 1,608 m, on the Kerala-Karnataka border.

### Perfectly capturing the unique charm of Trekking-style tours

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Brahmagiri Hills for Trekking
0 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 7:30 am – 9:30 am (trek start slots every 30 minutes)
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Trekking
- Fee: Group of 5 INR 3,500 incl. guide (INR 700 per extra person); single adult INR 1,300 incl. guide; foreigners INR 7,000 for 5
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 85476 02511, +91 85476 02506
Brahmagiri: The Brahmagiri hills lie between Wayanad and Kodagu. The guided trek starts at the forest department camp at Thirunelli and takes a little over 3 hours to the summit, through forest with small waterfalls and wildlife. Morning slots only; students must be over 15. The Thirunelli temple stands on the lower slope.

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/brahmagiri-hills-wayanad).

## Chain Tree, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-chain-tree-cultural-heritage-wayanad.html

Ficus tree with a chain around it beside the highway at Lakkidi, tied to the folk legend of the tribal guide Karinthandan.

### Rich Cultural Heritage & Tribal Traditions

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Chain Tree
15 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: Open during daytime, every day
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Heritage
- Fee: No entry fee
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Chain Tree: Local legend says a tribal youth, Karinthandan, showed a British engineer the route up the ghat into Wayanad and was then killed so the engineer could take the credit; his restless spirit was later said to be chained to this tree by a priest. A small shrine is kept at the tree. It stands by the road at Lakkidi, about 15 km from Kalpetta; entry is free.

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/chain-tree-lakkidi-wayanad), [keralatourism.org](https://keralatourism.org/destination/chain-tree-lakkidi/631), [onmanorama.com](https://onmanorama.com/travel/kerala/2018/06/30/travel-kerala-wayanad-exotic-getaway-changala-maram.html).

## Cheengeri Hill, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-cheengeri-hill-trucking-wayanad.html

Open rocky hill near Ambalavayal run by DTPC as a trekking spot, with views over the Karapuzha river and reservoir.

### Leaf, Lake & Land

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Cheengeri Hill
20 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Trekking
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Cheengeri Hill: Cheengeri is a gently sloping hill with little forest cover, about 2 km from Ambalavayal on the road from Sultan Bathery to Kaduvakuzhi. DTPC runs it as an authorised trekking and camping spot with ropes on the rocky upper section; mornings are recommended. It is open through the year.

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/adventure/cheengeri-hills), [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/kerala-article/2023/cheengeri-hills-trek-wayanad/1345), [onmanorama.com](https://onmanorama.com/travel/kerala/2022/03/15/wayanad-cheengeri-hills-destination-trekking.html).

## Chembra Peak, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-chembra-peak-trucking-wayanad.html

Wayanad's highest peak, about 2,100 m, near Meppadi; the guided trail passes a heart-shaped lake, Hridaya Thadakam.

### Biodiversity Hotspots, Crystal Waters & Terrain

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Chembra Peak
17 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 7:00 am – 3:00 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Trekking
- Fee: Entry INR 50 (foreigner INR 80); guided trek INR 4,000 for up to 5 people, INR 800 per extra person
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 493 628 2001
Chembra Peak: Chembra rises about 2,100 m above sea level south of Kalpetta near Meppadi. The trail passes the heart-shaped Hridaya Thadakam lake. Treks are guided and need forest-department permission, are limited to 88 people, and the upper half of the route is restricted because of wildlife.

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/chembra-peak-wayanad).

## Chetalayam Falls, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-chetalayam-waterfall-wayanad.html

Small seasonal waterfall in forest about 12 km from Sulthan Bathery, reached on foot; it runs low or dry in summer.

### Roaring Waters & Jungle Echoes

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Chetalayam falls
34 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Falls
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Chetalayam falls: Chethalayam is one of the smaller and less-visited falls of Wayanad, set in forest near Sulthan Bathery and reached by a trek through woodland. A cascade drops into a clear pool. It is seasonal: Kerala Tourism notes it dries up in summer, so it is best seen in or after the monsoon.

Sources: [keralatourism.org](https://keralatourism.org/destination/chethalayam-falls-wayanad/557), [keralatourism.org](https://keralatourism.org/wayanad/waterfalls-wayanad.php), [prod.incredibleindia.gov.in](https://prod.incredibleindia.gov.in/content/incredible-india-v2/en/destinations/wayanad/chethalyam-falls.html).

## Edakkal Caves, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-edakkal-caves-trucking-wayanad.html

Natural rock caves on Ambukuthi hills, 10 km from Sultan Bathery, with ancient engravings of human figures and animals.

### Wilderness Walks & Nature Trails

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Edakkal Caves
4 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 8:30 am – 4:00 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (November-March)
- Type: Trekking
- Fee: Adult INR 50, child INR 30
- Duration: 2-3 hours
- Holiday: Mon
- Contact: +91 493 621 5339, +91 94466 02134, +91 94460 52134
Edakkal Caves: The caves are two natural rock formations about 1,200 ft up the Ambukuthi hills, formed by a split in a huge rock and found in 1895. Their walls carry ancient engravings and scripts, and the site was occupied several times, the oldest phase dating to the Stone Age. A steep climb leads up; daily visitors are capped at 1,920.

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/edakkal-caves-wayanad).

## En Ooru Tribal Village, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-en-ooru-tribal-wayanad.html

Kerala's first tribal heritage village, at Pookode near Vythiri, with traditional huts, performances and tribal craft stalls.

### Discovering Tribal Heritage: A Journey Off the Beaten Path

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### En Ooru
16 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 9:00 am – 5:00 pm (Mon–Fri), 9:00 am – 6:00 pm (Sat, Sun, holidays)
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Tribal
- Fee: Adult INR 50 (camera INR 150, shuttle INR 40)
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 62380 71371
En ooru: Enooru at Pookode, about 5.6 km from Vythiri bus stand, presents the customs, architecture and crafts of Wayanad's tribal communities. Visitors see traditional huts, an amphitheatre with tribal music and dance, and stalls selling tribal medicines, handicrafts and products. A shuttle jeep runs up to the village; tickets are sold offline only.

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/enooru-wayanad).

## Heritage Museum, Ambalavayal, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-folklore-museum-wayanad.html

Archaeological and heritage museum at Ambalavayal with tribal artefacts, hero stones and finds from the Neolithic age onwards.

### Wayanad Heritage Museum, Ambalavayal

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Wayanad Heritage Museum, Ambalavayal
12 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 9:00 am – 5:30 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Museum
- Fee: Adult INR 30, child INR 20; multimedia show INR 50
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 493 629 4668, +91 75938 92955
Wayanad Heritage Museum: The Wayanad Heritage Museum at Ambalavayal, about 12 km from Sultan Bathery, holds artefacts found in the Wayanad area in four blocks: Veerasmruthi (hero stones and warrior memorials), Gothrasmruthi and Jeevanusmruthi (tribal life) and Devasmruthi (objects from the Neolithic age to the 17th century). Entry 9:00 am to 5:30 pm; adults INR 30, children INR 20 (DTPC Wayanad).

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/wayanad-heritage-museum-wayanad).

## Gurukula Botanical Sanctuary, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-gurukula-botanical-sanctuary-wayanad.html

Gurukula Botanical Sanctuary near Periya, Wayanad: a conservation garden of native Western Ghats plants founded in 1981; day tours Monday to Saturday.

### Gurukula Botanical Sanctuary, Periya

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Gurukula Botanical Sanctuary
About 57 km from Kalpetta by road, near Periya
- Type: Botanical sanctuary (private, visits by day tour)
- Timing: 9:00 am – 4:00 pm (day tours, Monday to Saturday)
- Holiday: Sun
- Fee: not published
- Contact: +91 702 509 7426
Gurukula Botanical Sanctuary is a conservation garden near Periya in northern Wayanad, founded by Wolfgang Theuerkauf in 1981 at the edge of a rainforest reserve. It grows rare and threatened plants of the Western Ghats, among them ferns, mosses, balsams, orchids, aroids and gingers, and returns them to the wild.

Visits are by botanical day tour, Monday to Saturday, offered in several languages including English and Malayalam; book ahead with the sanctuary. Sources: [gbsanctuary.org](https://gbsanctuary.org/daytour/), Rainforest Concern.

## Irrupu Falls, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-irrupu-waterfall-wayanad.html

Waterfall of about 170 ft on the Lakshmana Tirtha river in the Brahmagiri Hills of Kodagu, Karnataka, near the Wayanad border.

### Silver Streams & Rocky Descents

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Irrupu falls
60 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: Open all year; daily hours not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Falls
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Irrupu falls: Iruppu falls about 170 ft from the Lakshmana Tirtha river; legend says Lakshmana shot an arrow into the hill to bring out the stream. The Rameshwara temple on the trail draws pilgrims, especially at Shivaratri. A walk of about 1 km leads to the falls, which Karnataka Tourism says are open all year; the flow is lowest from December to February.

Sources: [karnatakatourism.org](https://karnatakatourism.org/en/attractions/iruppu-falls/), [onmanorama.com](https://onmanorama.com/travel/outside-kerala/2018/07/07/iruppu-waterfalls-karnataka-wayanad-border.html).

Kanthanpara Falls: Kanthanpara is a smaller waterfall, about 100 ft high, on the Vaduvanchal road 8 km from Meppadi and about 19 km from Kalpetta, close to the Meppadi range of the South Wayanad Forest Division. DTPC mentions an optional trek of about two hours along the Kanthanpara river.

## Karapuzha Dam, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-karapuzha-dam-romantic-wayanad.html

Earth dam 625 m long and 28 m high on the Karapuzha river, built for irrigation, with gardens and an adventure park.

### Misty Jungles, Reservoirs & Plains

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Karapuzha Dam
16 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 9:00 am – 6:00 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Romantic
- Fee: Adult INR 30, child INR 10
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 493 620 2246
Karapuzha Dam: Karapuzha is an earthen irrigation dam, 625 m long and 28 m high, on the Karapuzha river. The DTPC park beside the reservoir has landscaped gardens and walkways, a children's park, a watchtower, boating and paid rides such as a zipline, giant swing and VR zone. The reservoir area is also visited for birdwatching.

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/karapuzha-dam-wayanad).

## Karlad Lake, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-karland-lake-romantic-wayanad.html

Natural freshwater lake at Thariode, 3 km from Banasura Sagar Dam, home to DTPC's Wayanad Adventure Camp with a zipline over the water.

### Crystal Torrents & Emerald Pools

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Karlad Lake
15 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 9:00 am – 5:00 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Romantic
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Karlad Lake: Karlad Lake is believed to have formed after a landslide about two centuries ago. DTPC's adventure camp here offers kayaking, a zipline across the lake, rock climbing, boating, bamboo rafting and nature walks, with life jackets and instructors on site. DTPC says children under 10 are not permitted (it appears to refer to the zipline).

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/adventure/karlad-lake), [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/adventure-tourism/zip-line/karlad-lake), [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karalad_Lake).

## Keluvaidyar, Kattikulam, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-keluvaidyar-kattikulam-health-wayanad.html

Keluvaidyar, a Kurichya tribal herbal healer in Kattikulam, Mananthavady, Wayanad. What a 2014 blog reports and what is not published. Not medical advice.

### Keluvaidyar: traditional tribal healer in Kattikulam

#### Tribal herbal medicine in Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Keluvaidyar, Kattikulam
About 34 km from Kalpetta by road (area of Kattikulam)
- Type: Health & Wellness, tribal herbal medicine
- Location: Kattikulam, Mananthavady, Wayanad
- Timing: not published
- Fee: not published
- Contact: not published
Keluvaidyar is a traditional herbal healer of the Kurichya tribal community in Kattikulam, a town in the Mananthavady area. The blog says he is widely sought out, with patients travelling to him from other cities.

Among the ailments it mentions are asthma, diabetes and skin conditions such as psoriasis and eczema. The post also describes how tribal healers keep their recipes secret and how little of this knowledge is written down.

Please note: this is not medical advice and BWStays has not verified what the blog reports. See a qualified doctor for any health problem. We will add timings, fees and contact details once they are confirmed with the healer. Also see [Vellanvaidyar of Thirunelli](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-vellanvaidyar-thirunelli-health-wayanad.html).

Source: [Tribal medicine and its practitioners](https://kallivalli.blogspot.com/2014/04/tribal-medicine-and-its-practitioners.html), Kallivalli blog (2014), summarised in our own words.

## Kolagapara Trek, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-kolagapara-trucking-wayanad.html

Hill with a large monolithic rock about 5.5 km from Meenangadi, climbed on a steep 2 km trail through forest patches and tea gardens.

### Wild Greenery, Ponds & Lowlands

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Kolagapara Trekking
4 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 6:00 am – 6:00 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Trekking
- Fee: No entry fee
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Kolagapara: The roughly 2 km climb to the top is steep in places and passes forest patches and tea plantations rich in plants and birds. The summit gives views of the surrounding hills and, on clear days, Krishnagiri cricket stadium. Local buses run from Meenangadi and Sulthan Bathery; DTPC Kalpetta can arrange guided visits to nearby tribal settlements.

Sources: [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/destination/kolagappara-wayanad-unexplored/779/).

## Koottamundu Glass Temple, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-koottamundu-glass-temple-pilgrimage-wayanad.html

Jain temple of Parswanatha Swami on the slopes of Vellarimala near Koottamunda, known for its mirror-lined inner walls.

### Pilgrimage Paths, Monsoon Cascades & Faith Valleys

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Koottamundu Glass Temple
7 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Pilgrimage
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Koottamundu Glass Temple Wayanad: The temple, about 20 km from Kalpetta, is dedicated to Parswanatha Swami. Its sanctum holds icons of Parswanatha Swami and Padmavathi Devi, and mirrors on the inner walls reflect the idols in repeating patterns, which gives it the name Glass Temple.

Sources: [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/wayanad/glass-temple-koottamunda.php).

## Kurumbalakotta, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-kurumbalakotta-romantic-wayanad.html

A hill in Kottathara panchayat near Venniyode, about 991 m high, climbed at dawn for views over the Wayanad plateau.

### Pristine Woodlands, Creeks & Depressions

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Kurumbalakotta
18 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Romantic
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Kurumbalakotta: Kurumbalakkotta is a monolithic hill of about 991 m in Kottathara panchayat, near Venniyode, reached from Kalpetta via Kambalakkad. Kerala Tourism describes a moderate trek through tall grass with no formal path, and the Kurumbalakkotta Bhagavathy temple on the way down. Wikipedia notes a large landslide on the hill in July 2024; check access locally.

Sources: [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kurumbalakotta), [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/kerala-article/2014/kurumbalakkotta-peak-wayanad/506).

## Kuruwa Deep, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-kuruwa-deep-trucking-wayanad.html

950-acre protected river delta of forested islets in the east-flowing Kabani river, reached by raft.

### Lagoons, Lake & Land

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Kuruwa Deep
33 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 9:00 am – 3:30 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Trekking
- Fee: Adult INR 220, student INR 100 (foreigner INR 440)
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 75938 92956
Kuruwa Deep: Kuruva is a protected cluster of islands in the Kabani river. Visitor entry is capped at 488 people per day, tickets are sold offline only, and rafting, kayaking and paddling are offered inside. Entry 09:00-15:30, activities to 16:30.

## Lakkidi Ghats View Point, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-lakkidi-ghats-view-point-wayanad.html

Roadside viewpoint at the top of the Thamarassery ghat pass, about 700 m up and 5 km from Vythiri, overlooking the hairpin bends.

### Flora Paradise, Monsoon Waters & Elevation

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Lakkidi Ghats View Point
16 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Trekking
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Lakkidi Ghats View Point: Lakkidi sits at about 700 m (2,296 ft) at the crest of the Thamarassery ghat and is known as the gateway of Wayanad. The view looks down over the hairpin road and valley towards Kozhikode. The Chain Tree, linked to the legend of the tribal guide Karinthandan, is nearby. It is a roadside stop with no ticket listed.

Sources: [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/wayanad/view-lakkidi.php), [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/chain-tree-lakkidi-wayanad).

## Mailadippara, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-mailadippara-romantic-wayanad.html

A rocky hill on the eastern edge of Kalpetta, near the Civil Station and the bypass road, climbed on foot for views over the town.

### Love Nests Among Misty Hills

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Mailadippara Romantic
3 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Romantic
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Mailadippara: Myladippara is a cliff-like hill just east of the Kalpetta Civil Station, next to the national highway bypass. It is reached by a short walk up from the road and is visited for its view over Kalpetta town. No official timing, fee or management body is published for it.

Sources: [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tourist_attractions_in_Kalpetta).

## Pazhassi Tomb, Mananthavady, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-mananthavady-pazhassi-tomb-heritage-wayanad.html

Memorial and museum at Mananthavady on the Kabani riverbank, where Pazhassi Raja was cremated in 1805.

### Museum & Freedom Fighter Legacy

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Mananthavady Pazhassi Tomb
30 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 9:00 am – 5:30 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Heritage
- Fee: Adult INR 30, child INR 20
- Holiday: Mon
- Contact: +91 75938 92958
Mananthavady Pazhassi Tomb: Pazhassi Raja, ruler of the former Kottayam kingdom, fought the East India Company from 1793 until his death in 1805 and was cremated here. The tomb was turned into a museum in 1996 and holds relics linked to him, including a sword. The Kerala State Archaeology Department manages the site. Tickets are sold at the counter only.

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/pazhassi-smarakam-wayanad).

## Meenangadi Church, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-meenangadi-church-pilgrimage-wayanad.html

Syriac Orthodox Marian pilgrim church at Meenangadi, known for the relic of St. Mary's girdle (Soonoro).

### Sacred Churches & Divine Sanctuaries

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Meenangadi Church
14 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Pilgrimage
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Meenangadi Church: St. Mary's church at Meenangadi belongs to the Syriac Orthodox Church and was consecrated on 1 February 1958. It holds the Holy Soonoro (girdle of St. Mary), installed in 1991, and relics of Patriarch Ignatius Elias III. Its main feast is the eight-day lent and Nativity of St. Mary feast, 1 to 8 September.

Sources: [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St._Mary%27s_Church,_Meenangadi), [syriacpatriarchate.org](https://syriacpatriarchate.org/2024/02/visit-st-mary-soonoro-church-in-meenangadi/).

## Meenmutty Falls, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-meenmutty-waterfall-wayanad.html

Three-tier waterfall about 5 km from Banasura Sagar Dam, with a total drop that DTPC gives as over 800 ft.

### Your comfortable and affordable stays in Kalpetta

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Meenmutty Falls
41 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 10:00 am – 5:00 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Falls
- Fee: Adult INR 100, student INR 50, foreigner INR 200
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 85476 02722
Meenmutty Falls: The first tier is a short walk from the parking ground, the second is reached by steps built over boulders, and the third needs a stream crossing over slippery rocks with ropes. The top gives views of Banasura Sagar Dam and the valleys. Do not confuse it with the Meenmutty falls near Meppadi, which is closed to visitors.

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/banasura-meenmutty-waterfalls-wayanad), [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Meenmutty_Falls_(Wayanad)).

## Munneswaran Kunnu, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-munneswaran-kunnu-romantic-wayanad.html

Grassy hilltop near Thalappuzha in Mananthavady taluk, reached by a steep walk from Makkimala, with a small Shiva shrine on top.

### Hill Station Hikes & Mountain Climbs

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Munneswaran Kunnu
42 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Romantic
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Munneswaran Kunnu: The track to the top starts at the Makkimala tribal settlement, about 5 km from Thalappuzha town, and ends with a steep climb of roughly 500 m over grassland. The summit, around 950 to 1,000 m high, has a small Shiva shrine and views over north-eastern Wayanad; it is often called the 'Vagamon of Wayanad'.

Sources: [onmanorama.com](https://www.onmanorama.com/travel/kerala/2018/04/07/muneeswaran-hills-wagamon-of-wayanad.html), [onmanorama.com](https://onmanorama.com/travel/kerala/2020/09/26/muneeswaran-hill-wayanad-vagamon.html), [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thalappuzha,_Wayanad).

## Muthanga Wildlife Sanctuary, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-muthanga-wildlife-sanctuary-wayanad.html

Southern part of Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary near Sulthan Bathery, visited by Forest Department jeep and bus safaris.

### Wild Sanctuaries, Watercourses & Gradients

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Muthanga Wildlife Sanctuary
24 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 6:00 am – 10:00 am, 3:00 pm – 6:00 pm (safari slots, DTPC)
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Wildlife
- Fee: Bus safari INR 350 adult, INR 175 child/student, INR 700 foreigner; jeep INR 2,100 for 4
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 99472 71015
Muthanga Wildlife Sanctuary: Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary (344 sq km, declared 1973) is in two separate blocks; Muthanga is the southern one, adjoining Bandipur (Karnataka) and Mudumalai (Tamil Nadu), and is part of Project Elephant. Elephants, gaur, deer, langurs and occasionally tigers are seen. Visitors may enter only the outer tourism zone on Forest Department safaris; jeeps are hired at the gate and seats are limited per slot.

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://dtpcwayanad.com/destination/muthanga-wildlife-sanctuary-wayanad), [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/wayanad/wayanad-wildlife-sanctuary.php), [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/ecotourism/trekking-programs/muthanga-jeep-safari/28).

## Nagarhole Wildlife Sanctuary, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-nagarhole-wildlife-sanctuary-wayanad.html

Tiger reserve in Karnataka next to Wayanad's Tholpetty sanctuary, with Forest Department safaris from the Kabini, Veeranahosahalli and Nanachi gates.

### Jungle Pathways, Fishponds & Foothills

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Nagarhole wild life sanctuary
42 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published (safari slots are set by the Karnataka Forest Department)
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Wildlife
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Nagarhole wild life sanctuary: Nagarahole adjoins the Tholpetty block of Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary in the north of the district. The Karnataka Forest Department runs bus, jeep and boat safaris from several gates, including Kakanakote on the Kabini backwaters and Nanachi in Kodagu. Safari times and fares were revised from June 2025; check them before travelling.

Sources: [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/wayanad/wayanad-wildlife-sanctuary.php), [outlooktraveller.com](https://www.outlooktraveller.com/News/nagarahole-tiger-reserve-revises-safari-timings-and-entry-fees), [deccanherald.com](https://www.deccanherald.com/india/karnataka/wildlife-safari-timin%20gs-fee-revised-at-nagarahole-tiger-reserve-3568318).

## Neelarchalu Lake, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-neelarchalu-lake-romantic-wayanad.html

Tribal village between Ambalavayal and Meppadi, surrounded on three sides by the Karapuzha reservoir, with a sunset viewpoint over the water.

### Ecological Treasures, Liquid Jewels & Landforms

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Neelarchalu Lake
49 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Romantic
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Neelarchalu: Nellarachal sits within the Karapuzha Dam reservoir, which curves around it on three sides; the name likely comes from nellu (paddy), as parts of the reservoir were paddy fields. The Karapuzha viewpoint has bamboo seating facing the water for sunset. Local hosts arrange village experiences such as visits to Kurichya homes; Edakkal Caves is about 10 km away.

Sources: [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/destination/nellarachal-wayanad-unexplored/761/), [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/kerala-article/village-tour-nellarachal-wayanad/452/).

## Neelimala View Point, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-neelimala-view-point-romantic-wayanad.html

A hilltop viewpoint near Vaduvanchal, reached by jeep track and a trek, known for its view of Meenmutty falls.

### Honeymoon Haven & Starlit Nights

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Neelimala view point
26 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Romantic
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Neelimala view point: Neelimala, near Vaduvanchal, is named for the blue mist over the hills at dawn. Kerala Tourism describes a jeep ride followed by a trek past coffee plantations, grassland and boulders to a top that looks over Meenmutty falls and the Western Ghats. No official timing or fee is published, and access may be restricted by the forest department.

Sources: [keralatourism.org](https://keralatourism.org/destination/neelimala-hills-wayanad/423), [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tourist_attractions_in_Kalpetta).

## Lourdes Shrine, Pallikunnu, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-our-lady-of-lourdes-shrine-pilgrimage-wayanad.html

Latin Catholic church of Our Lady of Lourdes at Pallikunnu, founded in 1908 by the French priest Fr. Jefreno.

### Holy Churches & Spiritual Journeys

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Our Lady of Lourdes Shrine, Pallikunnu
14 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 7:00 am – 7:00 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Pilgrimage
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 493 628 6623
Our Lady of Lourdes Shrine, Pallikunnu: The church, known as Pallikunnu Church, was established in 1908 by Fr. Jefreno, a French priest, and follows some local Hindu customs. Its annual festival runs for three days from 10 February. DTPC lists it as about 10 km from Kalpetta.

## Pakshipathalam, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-pakshipathalam-wildlife-sanctuary-wayanad.html

Pakshipathalam wild life Birds sing love songs in this hidden paradise. Trekking adventures & secluded cave romance in Wayanad's secret sanctuary

### Bird Watching, Tranquil Waters & Panoramas

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Pakshipathalam
42 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published (forest-department permission needed)
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (March-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-February)
- Type: Wildlife
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Pakshipathalam: Pakshipathalam is reached only on foot from Thirunelli, a trek of about 3-4 hours each way through deciduous forest, streams and rocky stretches. The caves hold a large bird colony, including the Edible Nest Swiftlet, and gaur, elephants and Malabar giant squirrels live around it. Local lore links the caves to Garuda and the Pandavas. Prior permission from the Forest Department is needed.

Sources: [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/destination/pakshipathalam-wayanad/298), [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/wayanad/pakshipathalam-brahmagiri-hills.php).

## Papanasini River, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-papanasini-river-temple-pilgrimage-wayanad.html

Sacred mountain stream from the Brahmagiri hills, about 1 km from Thirunelli temple, where devotees perform rites for ancestors.

### Pilgrimage Trails, Blessed Waterfalls & Spiritual Dales

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Papanasini River
49 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Pilgrimage
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Papanasini River: Papanasini flows down from Brahmagiri near the Thirunelli Maha Vishnu temple. By tradition its water washes away sins, and devotees bathe in it and offer rites (bali, pinda) for ancestors on its banks. It is reached on foot from the temple.

Sources: [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/wayanad/thirunelli-temple-mananthavady.php), [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/thirunelli-temple-wayanad).

## Phantom Rock, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-phanthom-rock-romantic-wayanad.html

A skull-shaped granite rock formation near Ambalavayal, named after the comic hero the Phantom and reached by a short trek.

### Hiking Heaven & Forest Pathways

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Phantom rock
19 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Romantic
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Phantom rock: Phantom Rock is a natural rock outcrop near Ambalavayal whose shape resembles a human skull, which gave it the name of the comic-strip hero the Phantom. The last stretch is on foot along narrow trails; Edakkal Caves and Cheengeri hill are nearby. No official timing or fee is published.

Sources: [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phantom_Rock), [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/destination/phantom-rock-wayanad/678/), [wayanad.gov.in](https://wayanad.gov.in/en/tourist-place/phantom-rock/).

###### Karapuzha Dam

## Pookode Lake, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-pookode-lake-romantic-wayanad.html

Natural freshwater lake at 770 m near Vythiri, about 12 km from Kalpetta, shaped roughly like the map of India, with boating.

### Tree Tunnels, Springs & Undulations

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Pookode Lake
13 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 9:00 am – 6:00 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Romantic
- Fee: Adult INR 40, child INR 30
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 75938 92951, +91 93872 95184
Pookode Lake: Pookode Lake lies at 770 m among forested hills near Vythiri and is said to resemble the map of India in outline. The Panamaram river, a tributary of the Kabini, rises here. Visitors can walk around the lake, hire pedal or row boats, see the aquarium and try the fish spa; tickets are sold at the counter only.

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/pookode-lake-wayanad).

## Sita Devi Temple, Pulpally, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-pulpally-sitadevi-temple-pilgrimage-wayanad.html

18th-century temple at Pulpally, one of the few in Kerala dedicated to Seetha Devi, with idols of Lava and Kusa.

### Devotional Jungles, Ritual Waters & Blessed Ravines

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Pulpally Sitadevi Temple
30 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 5:00 am – 12:30 pm, 5:30 pm – 7:30 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Pilgrimage
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 493 624 1175
Pulpally Sitadevi temple: The temple stands about 280 m from Pulpally bus stand and is managed by the Malabar Devaswom Board, with a member of the Kuppathode family as trustee. It is one of the few temples in Kerala dedicated to Seetha, and it also has idols of her sons Lava and Kusa, linking it to local Ramayana traditions.

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/seethadevi-lava-kusa-temple-wayanad), [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seetha_Devi_Temple).

## Sita Lav Kush Temple, Ponkuzhy, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-sita-lav-kush-temple-pilgrimage-wayanad.html

Ramayana-linked temple beside the Ponkuzhi river on the Sulthan Bathery-Mysore road, about 4 km from Muthanga.

### Holy Woodlands, Shrine Cascades & Devotional Hollows

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Sita Lav Kush Temple
41 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Pilgrimage
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Sita Lav Kush Temple ponkuzhy: Kerala Tourism lists the Ponkuzhi Sree Rama temple, where Rama, Sita, Lakshmana and Hanuman are worshipped, and a Seetha Devi-Hanuman temple at the same spot. Both are tiled-roof Kerala-style shrines by the Ponkuzhi river. Local myth says the temple pond was formed by Sita's tears.

Sources: [keralatourism.org](https://keralatourism.org/temples/wayanad/ponkuzhi-rama), [keralatourism.org](https://keralatourism.org/temples/wayanad/seetha-devi-lava-kusha).

## Soochipara Falls, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-soochipara-waterfall-wayanad.html

Three-tier forest waterfall near Meppadi, also called Sentinel Rock, about 23 km from Kalpetta; daily visitor numbers are capped.

### Waterfall Symphony & Forest Silence

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Soochipara Falls
23 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 8:00 am – 5:00 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Falls
- Fee: Adult INR 150, student INR 50, foreigner INR 300
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 85472 37513
Soochipara Falls: Soochipara falls in three tiers; the name comes from a needle-shaped cliff nearby that is used for rock climbing. DTPC limits entry to 500 visitors a day between 08:00 and 17:00, and tickets are sold at the counter only. Children under 10 enter free.

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/soochipara-waterfalls-wayanad), [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soochipara_Falls).

## Gandhi Museum, Kalpetta, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-stays-kalpetta-gandhi-museum.html

Gandhi Museum at Puliyarmala, Kalpetta: a memorial museum beside the Ananthanatha Swamy Jain temple, about 4 km from Kalpetta town. Black and White Stays, Wayanad.

### Gandhi Museum at Puliyarmala, Kalpetta

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Gandhi Museum
4 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Museum
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Gandhi Museum is a memorial museum at Puliyarmala, about 4 km from Kalpetta town centre, beside the Ananthanatha Swamy Jain temple. It stands in the former boarding house where Mahatma Gandhi rested during his visit to Wayanad in 1934.

Opening hours and entry fee are not published, so please check before you visit. Source: public listings about the Ananthanatha Swamy Jain temple and the Kalpetta tourist attractions.

## Valmiki Ashram, Sultan's Bathery, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-sultan-batthery-valmiki-ashram-heritage-wayanad.html

Simple thatched hermitage near Pulpally that local tradition links to Sage Valmiki and to Sita's stay in the forest.

### Historic Places & Monuments

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Sultan's Bathery Valmiki Ashram
32 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Heritage
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Sultan's Bathery Valmiki Ashram: Local belief holds that Sage Valmiki sheltered Sita here and that Lava and Kusa were born here. The site, at Ashramamkolli in Amarakuni on the Pulpally route, is a thatched hut with mud walls that Nayaka tribal families rebuild each year; visitors come to pray and meditate. It ties in with the Seetha Devi Lava Kusa temple at Pulpally.

Sources: [outlooktraveller.com](https://www.outlooktraveller.com/amp/story/destinations/india/flipping-through-the-forgotten-ramayanas-of-wayanad), [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seetha_Devi_Temple).

## Tea Museum, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-tea-museum-wayanad.html

Tea museum in the Achoor Estate of Harrisons Malayalam at Achoor, near Pozhuthana, on the history of tea growing in Wayanad.

### Tea Museum Collections & Antiquities

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Tea Museum
12 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 9:00 am – 6:00 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Museum
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Tea Museum: The museum covers about a century of tea growing in the region, with old machinery, tools and early photographs of the tea industry. Visitors can follow the process from green leaf to tea powder, taste several teas and buy Achoor estate tea on site. A 2018 news report says it occupies a renovated old tea factory on three floors.

Sources: [pozhuthanapanchayat.lsgkerala.gov.in](https://pozhuthanapanchayat.lsgkerala.gov.in/en/node/48), [onmanorama.com](https://onmanorama.com/news/kerala/2018/10/12/tea-museum-wayanad.html).

## Tholpetty Wildlife Sanctuary, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-tholpetty-wildlife-sanctuary-wayanad.html

Northern block of Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary, east of Mananthavady near Thirunelli, visited on Forest Department jeep safaris.

### Botanical Paradise, Aquatic Bodies & Topography

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Tholpetty wild life sanctuary
47 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 6:00 am – 10:00 am, 3:00 pm – 6:00 pm (safari slots, DTPC)
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Wildlife
- Fee: Jeep safari INR 2,100 for 4, INR 2,410 for 5, INR 2,725 for 6; foreigners INR 4,200-4,800
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 493 525 0853, +91 79075 43321, +91 99462 50853
Tholpetty wild life sanctuary: Tholpetty is the northern of the two blocks of Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary and borders Nagarahole in Karnataka. Forest Department jeep safaris in the outer tourist zone may show elephants, gaur, deer, langurs and, rarely, tigers, leopards and bears. Jeeps are booked at the counter (offline only).

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://dtpcwayanad.com/destination/tholpetty-wildlife-sanctuary-wayanad), [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/wayanad/wayanad-wildlife-sanctuary.php).

## Thusharagiri Falls, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-thusharagiri-waterfall-wayanad.html

Three waterfalls near Kodenchery in Kozhikode district, the tallest dropping about 75 m, within a few hundred metres of each other.

### Monsoon Cascades & Misty Trails

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Thusharagiri falls
34 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 6:00 am – 6:00 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Falls
- Fee: INR 30 per person
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Thusharagiri: Thusharagiri has three falls: Erattumukku, Mazhavil Chattom and Thumbithullumpara (Thenpara), 100-500 m apart. The tallest drops about 75 m. Forest trails lead to the upper falls. It is in Kozhikode district, about 50 km from Kozhikode city, and is managed with DTPC Kozhikode.

Sources: [keralatourism.org](https://keralatourism.org/kerala-article/2023/thusharagiri-waterfalls-kerala/1307), [incredibleindia.gov.in](https://www.incredibleindia.gov.in/en/kerala/kozhikode/thusharagiri-waterfalls), [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thusharagiri_Falls).

## Thirunelli Temple, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-tirunelli-temple-pilgrimage-wayanad.html

Ancient Maha Vishnu temple at Thirunelli, set in forest beside the Brahmagiri hills, about 32 km from Mananthavady.

### Sacred Groves, Divine Cascades & Holy Valleys

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Tirunelli Temple
48 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 5:30 am – 12:00 pm, 5:30 pm – 8:00 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Pilgrimage
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Tirunelli: The temple is dedicated to Vishnu in his four-armed form and is also called Sahyamala Kshetram and 'Kashi of the South'. It has granite pillars and stone aqueducts that bring water from the hills. Devotees perform rites for ancestors at the Papanasini stream, about 1 km away, and the temple pond Panchatheertham holds a rock called Vishnupada.

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/thirunelli-temple-wayanad), [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/wayanad/thirunelli-temple-mananthavady.php).

## Trikaipatta Temple, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-trikaipatta-temple-pilgrimage-wayanad.html

Shiva temple at Thrikkaipatta near Meppadi, Wayanad, with shrines to Ganesha, Ayyappa and the serpent deities.

### Ancient Temples & Divine Heritage

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Trikaipatta temple
12 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (March-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-February)
- Type: Pilgrimage
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Trikaipatta temple: Kerala Tourism lists the temple as dedicated to Lord Shiva, with idols of Ganesha, Ayyappa and Naga (serpent god). The name Thrikkaipatta is explained as 'bands on three hands' in Malayalam. No official timings or history are published.

Sources: [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/wayanad/thrikaipatta-shiva-temple.php).

## Trishileri Temple, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-trishileri-temple-pilgrimage-wayanad.html

Ancient Shiva temple about 8 km north-west of Mananthavady, ritually linked to the Thirunelli temple.

### Ancient Forests, Temple Streams & Prayer Gorges

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Trishileri Temple
36 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 6:00 am – 12:30 pm, 5:00 pm – 7:30 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Pilgrimage
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 493 525 0325
Trishileri temple: Kerala Tourism calls it one of the oldest temples in Kerala, with Lord Shiva as presiding deity. Ancestral rites at Thirunelli are traditionally completed with an offering here, and a small Jala Durga shrine stands in a water body fed from the Papanasini at Thirunelli. The annual festival falls in Meenam (March-April).

Sources: [keralatourism.org](https://keralatourism.org/temples/wayanad/thrissilery-shiva), [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/thalassery/pazhassi/thrissilery-mahadeva-temple), [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thrissilery_Shiva_Temple).

## Uravu Bamboo Village, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-uravu-bamboo-tribal-wayanad.html

A non-profit bamboo centre at Thrikkaipetta, about 10 km from Kalpetta, with a bamboo nursery, craft workshop and shop.

### Bamboo Thickets, Wetlands & Escarpments

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Uravu
11 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 9:30 am – 6:30 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Monsoon (June-September), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Tribal
- Fee: No entry fee
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Uravu: Uravu has worked since 1996 to revive bamboo crafts and livelihoods in Thrikkaipetta, the 'bamboo village'. Visitors can walk the bamboo plantations, take a guided tour of the processing workshop and buy furniture and handicrafts; a second outlet is near Pookode Lake. Kerala Tourism (August 2024) gives daily opening 09:30-18:30, no entry fee.

Sources: [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/kerala-article/2024/uravu-bamboo-ecotourism-wayanad/1436), [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/wayanad/uravu-bamboo-processing-centre.php), [thebetterindia.com](https://thebetterindia.com/264647/green-gold-uravu-bamboo-products-thrikkaipetta-kerala-support-artisans).

## Valliyoorkavu Temple, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-valliyoorkavu-temple-pilgrimage-wayanad.html

Bhagavathy temple near Mananthavady where Durga is worshipped as Vana Durga, Bhadrakali and Jala Durga.

### Temple Architecture & Spiritual Journeys

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Valliyoorkavu Temple
21 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: 6:00 am – 12:30 pm, 5:30 pm – 8:00 pm
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Pilgrimage
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: +91 493 524 0084
Valliyoorkavu temple: The temple dates to the 14th century and is known for a 14-day festival in Meenam (March-April) that starts when the sword of Valliyooramma is brought from Pandikkadavu; tribal chieftains hoist the flag on the seventh day. It is about 4 km from Mananthavady bus stand.

Sources: [dtpcwayanad.com](https://www.dtpcwayanad.com/destination/valliyoorkavu-bhagavathy-temple-wayanad), [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/wayanad/valliyoor-temple.php).

## Varampatta Mosque, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-varampatta-mosque-pilgrimage-wayanad.html

Mosque at Varambetta in Padinjarathara panchayat, described by Kerala Tourism as one of Wayanad's oldest, about 300 years old.

### Sacred Sanctuaries & Holy Pilgrimages

#### Discover the mystical valleys of Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Varampatta Mosque
21 km from Kalpetta
- Timing: not published
- Transportation: Public
- Seasons to Visit: Summer (February-May), Winter (October-January)
- Type: Pilgrimage
- Fee: not published
- Holiday: NA
- Contact: not published
Varampatta mosque: Kerala Tourism lists Varambetta as one of the oldest mosques in the district, about 300 years old by traditional estimate, around 15 km from Kalpetta. A Kerala Tourism festival brochure places it in Padinjarathara panchayat and lists an annual festival (nercha) in late March.

Sources: [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/wayanad/varambetta-mosque-kalpetta.php), [keralatourism.org](https://www.keralatourism.org/1000festivals/assets/uploads/pdf/1516018268-0.pdf).

## Vellanvaidyar, Thirunelli, Wayanad | Black & White Workations

URL: https://www.bwstays.com/bw-vellanvaidyar-thirunelli-health-wayanad.html

Vellanvaidyar, a Kurichya tribal herbal healer near the Thirunelli temple in Wayanad. What a 2014 blog reports and what is not published. Not medical advice.

### Vellanvaidyar: traditional tribal healer near Thirunelli

#### Tribal herbal medicine in Wayanad
Nearby Fun, Food & Fuel Spots
Wayanad

##### Vellanvaidyar, Thirunelli
About 48 km from Kalpetta by road (area of Thirunelli)
- Type: Health & Wellness, tribal herbal medicine
- Location: At the foot of the Thirunelli temple, Mananthavady, Wayanad
- Timing: not published
- Fee: not published
- Contact: not published
Vellanvaidyar is a traditional herbal healer of the Kurichya tribal community. The blog places his practice at the foot of the Thirunelli temple in northern Wayanad and says people come to him from far away, some after other treatment has not helped.

Among the ailments it mentions are asthma, diabetes and bone fractures, and it says he also treats children. The post also describes how tribal healers keep their recipes secret and how little of this knowledge is written down.

Please note: this is not medical advice and BWStays has not verified what the blog reports. See a qualified doctor for any health problem. We will add timings, fees and contact details once they are confirmed with the healer. Also see [Keluvaidyar of Kattikulam](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-keluvaidyar-kattikulam-health-wayanad.html) and the [Thirunelli temple](https://www.bwstays.com/bw-tirunelli-temple-pilgrimage-wayanad.html) nearby.

Source: [Tribal medicine and its practitioners](https://kallivalli.blogspot.com/2014/04/tribal-medicine-and-its-practitioners.html), Kallivalli blog (2014), summarised in our own words.

- Wayanad Heritage Museum Shop: Shopping place at Ambalavayal, Wayanad, Kerala. (map https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Wayanad+Heritage+Museum+Shop+Ambalavayal+Wayanad+Kerala)
- Vanamoolika Herbals: Wayanad farmers' and women's collective, started in 1991 to protect native medicinal plants, that grows and sells organic herbs and spices. (map https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Vanamoolika+Herbals+Mullenkolly%2C+Pulpally+Wayanad+Kerala)
